Soviet Doom — factory set «Танкоград», batch 4 (MAP04)

F3 · MAP04 · BACKLOG N6 · drafts for the CEO, nothing here is in assets/ · 2026-10-14 20:17

Batch 4, the factory «Танкоград» (MAP04, BACKLOG N6): the thirteen industrial pieces of MAP04-factory §7.2, as drafts. Brick and its whitewashed dado, rusted corrugated sheet, a chain and hook, cast-iron and grating floors, molten metal (4 frames), the two key doors, the portal (4 frames), a sliding gate, night glazing, the works banner and the two enemy banners. All procedural, one seed per piece, as the metro. The only lettering (the banner, the pass plates) is set in our own alphabet from assets/fonts/bigfont/ (D24, D27), so every piece reproduces byte for byte on both machines. Five pieces use palette v2 and say why on their card. Each card shows the piece at 4x, 1x, tiled 2x2, at ~light 128 and in place beside approved soviet-base and metro walls; the first section shows the factory assembled. Nothing here is in assets/.

1. The factory assembled

Drafts and approved pieces (soviet base, metro) side by side in two elevations and a floor strip, so the set can be judged as the same game. A coherence check, not a mockup of MAP04's rooms.

hall (2x)
hall, ~light 128 (2x)

Assembly hall (elevation). Top: clerestory SDWIND1 between SDBRCK1 piers, the two banners side by side high on the middle pier (where I recommend they hang). Middle: SDSLOG1 on SDBRCK1. Bottom: the SDBRCK2 dado, the yellow lock (approved SDSTAR1 | SDDOORY | SDSTAR1, as MAP04 builds it), SDRUST1, and SDCHAN1 hanging in front of SDBRCK2.

portal (2x)
portal, ~light 128 (2x)

Portal hall (elevation). Top: approved SDTUBB1 and SDTUNL1 (metro), SDGATE1, SDBRCK1, approved SDSTEL1 and SDCONC1. Bottom: the drum (approved SDSTEL1) round SDPORT1, then the red lock (approved SDSTAR1 | SDDOORR | SDSTAR1).

floor (2x)
floor, ~light 128 (2x)

Floors from above, left to right: approved SDFLR2, SDFLR1 (lane); SDFLR4, SDGRAT1, SDMOLT1 x2, SDGRAT1, SDFLR4; approved SDRAIL1, SDMFLR2 (metro), SDFLR2, SDFLR3.

2. The key doors from afar

The brief: the locked doors must read by colour from across the hall. Shown beside SDDOOR1 (✓) and averaged down to 1/8 size, which is about what a mip level keeps at the far end of the assembly hall. Yellow is a high value on green and holds even at ~light 128; red is a hue more than a value, so its door has the plate and the band to help, and MAP04 lights the red portal red (NOT VERIFIED in engine: K4).

4. What I need from you

  1. Yes / no per piece. Each card is independent; my verdict is on each one.
  2. The key doors (section 2): do the yellow and the red door read as theirs from across the hall? The pass plate says «ПРОПУСК» (pass), which ties the keys to MAP04's open point 3 (keys as passes).
  3. A finding for the level designer, not a texture question: MAP04 flanks both locks with the red SDSTAR1 plaques. At the yellow lock that frames the door; at the red lock it makes three red blocks in a row, and from afar the red door reads as the green leaf between reds rather than as the red one (section 2, the portals at 1/8). I would take the plaques off the red lock, or move them a tile out, and keep them at the yellow one. Your call with level-designer.
  4. Palette v2 for brick, the Legion's canton and the portal (no new version, D45's ramps): ok? The alternative brick in v1 is browner (rust_brown) and reads less as a Soviet works.
  5. The portal's colour (MAP04 open point 6): cobalt-white, not showing the other side. Keep, or ask for green / red-black.
  6. Value note (ART-BIBLE §6.1): brick, rust and the night glazing sit darker than the 0.45-0.70 wall band the bible asks for (a factory at light 80-128 is a dark place). The Reich's dark uniforms will separate less against SDBRCK1 than against concrete. The fix, if the walk shows it, is light and SDBRCK2's whitewash at fighting height, not a paler brick. Your call whether to accept it now or judge it in the map.
